newsitem.title: CANADA: CWB lowers July 97/98 wheat and barley PROs.
newsitem.headline: CWB lowers July 97/98 wheat and barley PROs.

text.p: The Canadian Wheat Board said Thursday it dropped by C$6 to C$9 a tonne its 1997/98 (Aug/July) Pool Return Outlook (PRO) for wheat, and cut by C$5 its feed barley PRO.
CWB's July forecast for durum and malting barley PROs remained unchanged from the prior month.
PROs are the CWB's estimate of crop year returns and do not constitute price guarantees.
Higher than expected U.S. hard red winter wheat output and good world growing weather pressured prices. The USDA's July 11 world wheat carry out estimate rose five milion tonnes.

Recent rains in Europe were expected to cut the amount of barley selected for malt and consequently increasing feed barley stocks. U.S. corn prices dropped substantially from last month and weighed on feed barley values.
Pool returns in Canadian dollars per tonne based on grain in store St. Lawrence or Vancouver:
CWRS=Canada Western Spring Wheat. CPSR=Canada Prairie Spring Red. CPSW=Canada Prairie Spring White. CWRW= Canada Western Red Winter. CWES=Canada Western Extra Strong.
CWSWS=Canada Western Soft White Spring. CWF=Canada Western Feed. CWAD=Canada Western Amber Durum. CW=Canada Western.
